title: Endpoint of a family of norm comparisons
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $A,B\in\mathbb R$. Suppose that for every integer $m\ge2$, $B\le\bigl((1+1/m)^{m+1}\bigr)^{2k}A^2$. Then $B\le e^{2k}A^2$.
replaced: Let $k\ge0$ be an integer and $A,B\in\mathbb R$. If $B\le((1+1/m)^{m+1})^{2k}A^2$ for every integer $m\ge2$, then $B\le e^{2k}A^2$.
